context_limit_note: OpenRouter does not expose the baseline Ollama num_ctx control. Sent each full document unchunked; OpenAI default endpoint advertised 1,050,000-token context.
structured_output: response_format=json_schema, strict=true, original task schema; endpoint advertised structured_outputs.
prompt_serialization: exact frozen local prompt + newline + blank line + PASSAGE TOKENS header + every [zero_based_id] token, matching benchmark.prompt_for

coref.protocol: official 10-fold CV test-fold union (each book held out once)

temperature_note: Omitted because OpenAI endpoint metadata did not advertise temperature; provider default applied.
reasoning_mode_note: Requested reasoning.effort=none and include_reasoning=false. Luna Pro is OpenRouter-described as the Pro serving variant; it remains a distinct model configuration from standard Luna.
provider_routing_note: provider.order=[OpenAI], allow_fallbacks=false, require_parameters=true. No service_tier parameter was sent; post-run generation metadata confirms default tier for all 195 requests.
observed_completion_usage_note: API-reported completion usage exceeds max_tokens=16384 on some long documents, while finish_reason remains stop and reasoning_tokens are reported as zero. The configured request value is preserved; usage totals use API-reported tokens.

reproduction_environment.generation_api: OpenRouter chat completions API; OpenAI provider, default service tier
reproduction_environment.reproduction_note: Requires /home/drew/booknlp_llm_experiment (or compatible private experiment checkout) and runtime OpenRouter credentials. The public repository intentionally omits licensed text and gold labels.
